notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Sarinth Steelseeker and Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Sarinth Steelseeker trigger, putting Moss-Pit Skeleton from the top of your library into your graveyard.
Resolve the Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
